description.zh:
身份证号。

当VerifyMetaType取值VEHICLE_3_META，此项必输。

> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文 。
> - 当paramType取值md5时，身份证号前6位明文+出生年月日md5加密（32位小写MD5）+身份证号后4位。
description.en:
The ID card number.

This parameter is required when VerifyMetaType is set to VEHICLE_3_META.

> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the first 6 digits of the ID card number in plaintext + the MD5-encrypted date of birth (32-bit lowercase MD5) + the last 4 digits of the ID card number.

description.zh:
参数类型：

- normal：不加密。
- md5：Md5加密。
description.en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- normal: not encrypted.
- md5: MD5-encrypted.

description.zh:
姓名
> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
> - 当paramType取值md5时，姓名第一个字MD5加密（32位小写MD5）+ 姓名其他部分明文。
description.en:
The name.
> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the MD5-encrypted first character of the name (32-bit lowercase MD5) + the remaining characters of the name in plaintext.

description.zh:
车牌号

> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
> -  当paramType取值md5时，输入车牌号除最后两位的其他部分明文+车牌最后两位字母MD5加密（32位小写MD5）
description.en:
The license plate number.

> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the license plate number excluding the last two characters in plaintext + the MD5-encrypted last two characters (32-bit lowercase MD5).

description.zh:
核验类型

> 
> - VEHICLE_2_META：二要素核验，姓名+车牌号核验；
> - VEHICLE_3_META：三要素核验，姓名+车牌号+身份证号核验；
description.en:
The verification type.

> 
> - VEHICLE_2_META: two-element verification. Verifies the name and license plate number.
> - VEHICLE_3_META: three-element verification. Verifies the name, license plate number, and ID card number.

descriptions.zh: 核验姓名、身份证号、车牌号、车辆类型的一致性，并支持返回车辆详情
descriptions.en: Verifies the consistency of the name, ID card number, license plate number, and vehicle type, and supports returning vehicle details.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth vehicle-meta-verify-v2 --param-type normal --vehicle-type 02 --verify-meta-type VEHICLE_3_META --identify-num 400000000000000001 --user-name '张0' --vehicle-num '陕A90000' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth VehicleMetaVerifyV2 --region cn-hangzhou --VerifyMetaType VEHICLE_3_META --UserName '张0' --VehicleType 02 --IdentifyNum 400000000000000001 --ParamType normal --VehicleNum '陕A90000'
